blocks.text: Data jama hone ke baad use analysis ke liye tayyar karna zaroori hai. Is mein data ko clean karna (ghaltiyan aur inconsistencies yani aapas mein na milne wali baatein hatana), use meaningful (samajh aane wale) tareeqe se organize karna aur analysis ke liye theek format mein badalna shamil hai. Jahan data missing (ghayab) ya ghalat ho, wahan researchers interpolation (aas paas ki qeematon se beech ki qeemat ka andaza) ya statistical adjustments (statistics se kiye gaye sudhaar) jaise tareeqe istemal kar sakte hain ta ke data sahi rahe.

Misal: Agar survey ke jawabon mein kuch information adhoori ho to missing values ka andaza available (jo paas hai) data se lagaya ja sakta hai. Sahi tayyari se analysis ke results reliable (bharose ke qabil) aur valid (sahi) hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Data ki tayyari ke teen kaam bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Ghaltiyan aur inconsistencies saaf karna, data ko samajh aane wale tareeqe se organize karna, aur use analysis ke liye theek format mein badalna (missing values handle karna bhi is mein shamil hai).

items: Tayyari: clean karna, organize karna, format badalna; missing data handle karna.
